mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by >2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as credit conditions tighten.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% and UNRATE < 6% but SPX 60-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS 3-month growth > 200k jobs but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 0.5% month-over-month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL m-o-m growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth slows by more than 1 percentage point year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7%, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 y-o-y growth slows by >1pp and UNRATE > 7% but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.
